name: AI Social Post Draft with Approval
summary: AI drafts a social media post on a topic you choose; you edit and approve it before it is posted to Bluesky.
description: Manual run with a topic: a local AI agent drafts a short social post (agent.ask, runtime claude — change it to any runtime `monoagentcli agent scan --installed` lists), you edit and approve it (`monoagentcli hil list` / the app), and only the approved text is posted to Bluesky. Run with: workflow templates run ai_social_post_draft --input '{"topic":"our new release"}'. Set the Bluesky credential (credential_id) first.

config.prompt:
Write one short social media post (under 280 characters, at most two hashtags) about: {{ $json.topic }}

Reply with the post text only.
